tools.name: signaturit_count_signatures
tools.description: Count signature requests, optionally by status and sent date. Signaturit API: GET /v3/signatures/count.json.

tools.name: signaturit_list_signatures
tools.description: List signature requests with their documents, signers and status. The result window (limit + offset) cannot exceed 10,000. Signaturit API: GET /v3/signatures.json.

tools.name: signaturit_get_signature
tools.description: Get one signature request with its documents, signer status and events. Signaturit API: GET /v3/signatures/{id}.json.

tools.name: signaturit_send_reminder
tools.description: Send a reminder email to the signers of a pending signature request. This emails a third party. Signaturit API: POST /v3/signatures/{id}/reminder.json.

tools.name: signaturit_cancel_signature
tools.description: Cancel a signature request. The signers can no longer sign the document. This cannot be undone. Signaturit API: PATCH /v3/signatures/{id}/cancel.json.

tools.name: signaturit_list_contacts
tools.description: List the saved signing contacts of the account. Signaturit API: GET /v3/contacts.json.

tools.name: signaturit_get_contact
tools.description: Get one saved contact. Signaturit API: GET /v3/contacts/{id}.json.

tools.name: signaturit_create_contact
tools.description: Save a new signing contact (email and name). Signaturit API: POST /v3/contacts.json.

tools.name: signaturit_update_contact
tools.description: Change the email or name of a saved contact. Signaturit API: PATCH /v3/contacts/{id}.json.

tools.name: signaturit_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a saved contact. This cannot be undone. Signaturit API: DELETE /v3/contacts/{id}.json.

tools.name: signaturit_list_templates
tools.description: List the signature templates of the account. Signaturit API: GET /v3/templates.json.

tools.name: signaturit_get_credits
tools.description: Get the used and remaining credits of the account, by type and period. Signaturit API: GET /v3/account/credits.json.
